news.headline: Susquehanna Maintains Neutral on Qualcomm, Lowers Price Target to $165
Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Qualcomm Following Quarterly Results
news.summary: Following Qualcomm's fiscal fourth-quarter earnings report, several financial institutions, including Baird, Morgan Stanley, and TD Cowen, adjusted their price targets for the company's stock.

news.headline: Arm Stock Is Falling Thursday: What's Going On?
news.summary: Arm stock falls 5% despite beating Q2 earnings with 27% revenue growth, hit by a broader post-earnings semiconductor selloff.

news.headline: Texas Instruments Announces New Industrial Communication Devices
news.summary: Texas Instruments has launched a new multiprotocol communications system-on-module and an IO-Link master to enhance interoperability in industrial automation and robotics.

news.headline: Texas Instruments Launches TICS100MOD, Industry’s Smallest Fully Featured Multiprotocol Module, And TIOM2212 IO-Link Master To Simplify Industrial Ethernet Integration For Connected Factories
